notes: Summary: Large EU-headquartered insurance group evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) to replace an on-prem model serving stack. Primary constraints: strict EU-only residency for EU customers, separate UK key custody for local regulated business, Canadian data residency for claims pipeline, and APAC region for a growing client base. Customer wants per-region control plane options or tenancy isolation per region. Key technical asks: KMS integration with HSM-backed keys (customer-managed keys preferred), audit logging with 7+ years retention and exportable WORM format, SSO/SAML with Okta attribute mapping, ability to pin model versions and enforce routing policies by region/customer tier. Latency target: tail P99 < 300ms for chat-support flows (after warm-up) and high-throughput embedding batches (10k req/day) with cost sensitivity on token billing. POC scope: private VPC control plane, regional model pinning, KMS key import workflow, and audit log export to their Splunk instance. Quotes from stakeholders: "We cannot have EU data traverse non-EU control planes" — Head of Data Privacy; "Need proof of HSM key custody separation for UK operations" — Security Lead. Practical next: technical KMS diagram, outline of rollout phases (EU-only pilot -> UK isolated tenancy -> Canada -> APAC), and estimated infra start dates. Stubs: pricing deck in Drive, security FAQ and SOC2 artifact link provided. Short-term ask: sign-off on technical POC plan and schedule vendor risk questionnaire meeting with legal.
